name: reflexion
title: Draft, critique, search, and revise an answer with citations

comparison.purpose: Drafts an answer about adopting AI coding assistants, critiques it, searches a small sample index for what the critique says is missing, and revises with citations. The machine counts revisions against MAX_REVISIONS instead of counting transcript messages, and keeps only citations to passages the run actually retrieved.

starters: How should a small team roll out an AI coding assistant?
What security and licensing risks come with AI coding assistants?
How can a team tell whether an AI coding assistant pays off?
